title: Adaptive multi-tab workflow replay
objective: Execute verified workflow/candidate Skill plans in a fresh BrowserCrew task session by remapping logical browser context, resolving current semantic targets, binding reusable inputs, preserving approval and demonstrated-boundary rules, and verifying each context-changing action.
constraints: never execute recorded source tab ids as current tab ids
never treat recorded element ids or semantic refs as current selectors
re-observe DOM/AX evidence before target actions and recover stale targets
map candidate logical tab refs to current BrowserCrew task-session tabs
bind reusable parameters at execution time
do not execute actions beyond boundary_step_id or boundary_action_id
verify after navigation tab changes and mutations
manual real-Chrome acceptance remains deferred by user
next_action: Implement the pure adaptive replay planner/executor contract first: accept the verified Record-to-Skill candidate plan, create a fresh logical-tab-to-session-tab mapping, execute only through existing BrowserCrew tools, resolve each target from fresh semantic evidence, stop at the demonstrated boundary, and add deterministic multi-tab/parameter/approval/stale-target tests before UI wiring.
